skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a row with 4 consecutive strikes, dealing 360% ATK DMG. Grants allies in the same row [Specialized Speed Up] for 1 round. Requires 0 Energy to activate. [Specialized Speed Up]: Sets their SPD to 90% of Zombieman's SPD. If their current SPD is higher, it remains unchanged.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a row with 4 consecutive strikes, dealing 500% ATK DMG. Grants allies in the same row [Specialized Speed Up] for 1 round. Requires 0 Energy to activate. [Specialized Speed Up]: Sets their SPD to 95% of Zombieman's SPD. If their current SPD is higher, it remains unchanged.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Speed Up], increasing SPD by 20%. If the main target's SPD is lower than Zombieman's SPD, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Speed Up], increasing SPD by 25%. If the main target's SPD is lower than Zombieman's SPD, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains [Specialized Speed Up], increasing SPD by 30%. If the main target's SPD is lower than Zombieman's SPD, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Before battle begins, grants all allies [Encourage] for 3 rounds. After receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Encourage]: Grants 2 Energy at the start of each round. [Regeneration]: While at least 1 ally remains, restores 60% Max HP before Zombieman's action. Can trigger up to 3 times.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Before battle begins, grants all allies [Encourage] for 5 rounds. After receiving fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration]. [Encourage]: Grants 3 Energy at the start of each round. [Regeneration]: While at least 1 ally remains, restores 60% Max HP before Zombieman's action. Can trigger up to 5 times.

effects.desc: The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
Speed ​​buff that while in effect allows the bearer and up to 6 allies to act against and overcome enemies with lower speed.
